Create function CDN.Prod_WartoscAtr(@Wartosc decimal(20,4), @KlasaAtr integer, @OBITyp smallint, @OBINumer int, @TimeStamp int = 2147483647, @PpcId int) returns decimal(20,4) as begin Declare @cWartosc varchar(100) if (@KlasaAtr <> 0 ) Begin if exists(select * from cdn.atrybutyklasy where atk_typ = 5 and atk_id = @KlasaAtr and @PpcId > 0) begin select @cWartosc = CDN.CLR_ProdObliczWartoscAtrSQL(@KlasaAtr, @PpcId) end else Select @cWartosc = isnull(CDN.AtrPobierzWartosc(@OBITyp, @OBINumer, 0, 1, @KlasaAtr, @TimeStamp), CDN.AtrPobierzWartosc(@OBITyp, 0, 0, 1, @KlasaAtr, @TimeStamp))
If (IsNumeric(@cWartosc) = 0) Set @Wartosc = 0 Else Set @Wartosc = @Wartosc * cast(@cWartosc as decimal(20,4)) End
return IsNull(@Wartosc,0) end
